title: Streaming a Procedural City as 3D Tiles
description: Streams a generated procedural city exported as explicit 3D Tiles 1.1 with GLB tile payloads: 1 root GLB, 59 spatial GLB tiles, 1,800 buildings, about 494k triangles and a 31 MB dataset. Tiles are frustum-culled by spatial bounds and selected by projected screen-space error.
